name: Breaker
description: A man in his early twenties, a loud, lovable spring-breaker who sings 2000s pop-rap party anthems.
build: A lanky adult build: narrow shoulders, long thin arms, a flat torso and long legs, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Light tan skin with pink sunburned shoulders and nose, bright blue eyes under light brows, a straight nose and a wide mouth.
hair: Spiky frosted hair: short dark-brown roots with bleached pale-yellow tips gelled up in points.
outfit: Big white shutter-shade sunglasses with wide horizontal slats across the eyes; a baggy sleeveless tank top in bright kelly green with one large bold white block number 07 on the chest; long baggy knee-length board shorts in bright yellow with wide bold green side stripes; white flip-flops; a thick chunky puka-shell necklace.
performance_style: Hyped party stance: feet wide, knees bouncing, chest pushed out. Both arms raised, the character-right and character-left hands open with fingers spread wide at head height, all fingers visible. Head tipped back, a whooping open grin.
location: A crowded spring-break beach party at midday: bright sand running to the bottom of the frame, a DJ booth under a striped canopy, inflatable palm trees, beach balls in the air, and a hard blue sky.
recognition_cues: a kelly-green tank top with a big white 07
yellow board shorts with green side stripes

sing.intent: Pop-rap vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand at the mouth, he bounces hard on both knees and pumps the character-left hand open overhead on the beat, then returns to the party stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a loud beach sound: the shoulders jump, the torso draws back and both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back into the opening stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: step the feet a little wider, bring the character-left forearm across the chest with the character-right hand open at the hip, and hold a steady grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: he runs in whooping, slides to a stop and lands in the party stance.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: he jumps in place, lands with both open hands thrown overhead in a whoop with the mouth wide open, and holds.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the energy drains out: the shoulders drop, both open hands hang limp at his sides, and his head hangs low with the chin toward the chest. He holds a standing, visibly deflated finish. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
